title: Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan
desc: At Durgawati's urging, Seeta gathers the courage to expose Phoolanmati and Dularchand's crimes before the village, but Dularchand later twists the case in his favour. Meanwhile, while trying to escape Purvi and Sarla's dangerous plot, Madhu is hit by a car, leaving Sneha shocked.

title: Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan
desc: Madhu's accident exposes the secret she and Sneha fought to protect. As Sneha confesses to faking her pregnancy for Madhu's sake, the family turns against her, while Purvi exploits the crisis to shift the blame squarely onto her.

title: Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan
desc: Siddhu is devastated when he learns that Sneha's pregnancy was a lie and vents his anguish by wrecking the room he had lovingly prepared for their future. Meanwhile, Dularchand and Phoolanmati continue plotting against Seeta, while tensions flare between Durgawati and Ganga at the hospital.

title: Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan
desc: Ganga struggles to come to terms with Sneha's betrayal despite Sahana's efforts to comfort her. Concerned for Sneha's safety, Sahana sets out to find her. Meanwhile, Purvi joins forces with Dularchand and Phoolanmati against Durgawati, while Sneha fears Siddhu's silence after returning home.

title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
desc: Aryavardhan asks Jhende to keep an eye on Meera and Yashvardhan. Yashvardhan asks Gayatri about the camera Rajnandini gifted him. Gayatri informs Aryavardhan and Jhende, leaving them worried. Meanwhile, Meera learns about a fashion show in Anu's neighborhood and calls Raghupati.

title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
desc: As Chandni Chowk gears up for Gopal's fashion show, Meera launches a revenge plot against Anu and her family. With Raghupati's help, an intruder steals the sarees and jewellery meant for the event, leaving the entire show on the brink of collapse.

title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
desc: Aryavardhan manages to catch the thief and recover the stolen jewellery, post which the fashion show concludes successfully, and the investors agree to invest in Gopal and Pushpa's business. Meanwhile, Meera asks Harshvardhan to search the camera in Anu and Aryavardhan's room.

title: Tumm Se Tumm Tak
desc: As Anu and Aryavardhan excitedly prepare for their first Diwali, fresh tensions emerge elsewhere. Meera urges Yashvardhan to search for his missing camera, while Aryavardhan and Jhende grow suspicious of his intentions. Later, Anu decides to meet Meera after overhearing their conversation.
